description: Get the routed driving commute for a job site. Drive times use typical weekday rush-hour traffic. Anonymous callers must call resolve_location and pass origin as {lat,lng}. Connected callers may use a saved origin with filters:read. location_index comes from search_jobs.

origin.description: Driving start coordinates from resolve_location as {lat,lng}; required for anonymous callers.

name: get_commute_time
title: Calculate a driving commute
